text: Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with only organization_id set, Then the PATCH payload carries only organization-id and the response reflects the updated organization

Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with restricted=True and separately restricted=False, Then the PATCH payload carries restricted as true/false respectively (False is not dropped as if absent)
Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with a mix of old (traits) and new (organization_id) fields, Then the PATCH payload carries exactly those fields, nothing more

Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with only pre-existing fields (e.g. name), Then the PATCH payload is byte-for-byte unchanged from pre-PRD-21622 behavior (regression)

Given a valid flexible asset id, When update_flexible_asset is called with all five fields (name, traits, archived, organization_id, restricted) left None, Then the tool returns the invalid_argument error and makes no HTTP call (regression, now covering five fields instead of three)
Given an id that does not exist in IT Glue, When update_flexible_asset is called with any valid field (old or new), Then the tool returns the not_found error (regression)

Given the full test suite after this change, When tests/test_tools.py's baseline and backward-compatibility checks run, Then every other tool's schema is unchanged and no new required parameter or module-level state was introduced
